inputs_and_expected: Implement sc_clock and sc_run for the exact original ISA in CONTRACTS.md. Program: LI r1,3; LI r2,1; SUB r1,r1,r2; BNZ r1,2; ST r1,5; LD r3,5; HALT. It commits11 instructions with r1 trace [3,3,2,2,1,1,0,0,0,0,0], final registers [0,0,1,0], memory[5]=0 and halted1. Run budget4 then resume budget7 and obtain the same final state. For SUB r0,r0,r1 with old values9,3, result6; reading an already updated destination is wrong. Invalid LD address16, unknown opcode, impossible register, out-of-program branch and nonhalt falloff must preserve state/control. Commit UINT32_MAX rejects before wrap. HALT is stable; zero budget is not a halt instruction. Invalid initial control rejects even at budget0.
limits: Bounded independent model, same author, not an independent human assessment.
